headline: Chest-high SE swell but short and lumpy — grovel it early before the wind adds up.
today: Solid size on paper at 3-plus feet, but it's all packed into 4-6 second periods so expect mushy, fast-closing sections rather than clean walls. Wind stays cross out of the W all day, lightest at dawn and building to 12mph by evening, so get it early around the morning high before it gets bumpy. Fish or groveler is the call — nothing here rewards a big board.

daysToWatch.note: Smaller at 2ft but longer 6-7s period and N offshore wind all morning — cleanest window of the stretch. Log or groveler and enjoy the glass.
Swell nudges back to 3ft with light early winds and cross-off through morning. Short period again but worth a dawn check.
